entries.title: Follow Third Space updates
changes: Open Updates in the footer to read what changed and when, including the earlier history.

entries.title: A living forest
changes: Trade with forest villagers, use Strength and Speed potions, and build relationships through shared adventures.
Help an endangered traveler in the shared Lantern Road rescue. Existing keeper stories and your inventory carry forward.
Combat warnings, mobile movement, conversation prompts and the game canvas fit more reliably as the screen changes size.

entries.title: Clearer journal actions
changes: The journal shows when an action is pending and explains its outcome. Repeated clicks and changes of location handle feedback more reliably.

entries.title: Reliable exits from interiors
changes: Leave interiors without waiting on a delayed entry transition.

entries.title: The keeper and a wider forest
changes: Explore a larger shared forest with interiors, a keeper story, clues and side stories.

entries.title: More company among the trees
changes: Meet shared forest characters. The mimic approaches from out of sight, and navigation is more reliable.

entries.title: Your inventory within reach
changes: A five-slot hotbar lives inside the game view, keeping your items close while you explore.

entries.title: Survival in the forest
changes: Manage hunger, carry a backpack, gather food and use a knife in shared forest encounters.

entries.title: Hold to sprint
changes: Hold sprint and recover stamina for another run. Catch feedback remains visible with reduced motion enabled.

entries.title: A new forest mimic
changes: A shared mimic joins the forest, with stronger catch presentation that returns you to play.

entries.title: Forest catches and shared greetings
changes: Forest catches have brief closeups that finish, and the clown greets the group together.

entries.title: A game menu and a bigger projector
changes: Use the full-game menu, see a larger in-world projector, and open chat with more reliable keyboard focus.

entries.title: More ways to spend time together
changes: Forest encounters and social interactions are more readable, with improved footsteps, catch presentation and chat timestamps.
Share a room invite and return to the game more reliably after closing panels.

entries.title: Catch up with the group
changes: When you enable playback on a blocked device, the video catches up to the shared position.

entries.title: A bigger shared screen
changes: The shared projector is larger, with controls kept within reach.

entries.title: Tap to join shared playback
changes: Enable playback on your device with a tap and see which video everyone is watching.

entries.title: Easier returns and mobile movement
changes: Find ongoing sessions and recover movement, idle presence and mobile controls more reliably.

entries.title: Legible controls after dark
changes: Dark controls are easier to read, and shared video stays visible beneath its controls.

entries.title: Third Space opens to friends
changes: The public site brings persistent multiplayer rooms and clearer mobile entry screens.

entries.title: Watching controls and flashlight charge
changes: Control shared video over the picture and keep your fresh flashlight charge.

entries.title: Races, maps and the projector
changes: Meet in a shared race lobby, use a walking map, and watch on the asylum projector.

entries.title: A quieter asylum
changes: The asylum gains quiet ambience and TV static that changes with your distance.

entries.title: Finding your way after dark
changes: Forest ambience stays continuous, with local lights to help you find your way.

entries.title: Smoother shared YouTube playback
changes: Shared YouTube playback no longer gets interrupted by routine clock updates.

entries.title: More to explore at camp
changes: Explore the campsite, keep a shared TV queue, and use more resilient movement controls.

entries.title: Pick up where you left off
changes: Recover your room after refresh or a lost connection. Choosing to leave still ends your visit.

entries.title: Midnight Pines, closer to hand
changes: Start in Midnight Pines, travel with simpler controls, and see connection health.

entries.title: Forest sound and softer returns
changes: Hear sounds from their direction in the forest, peek from the quiet campfire, and return with a respawn fade.

entries.title: Something in the forest
changes: Encounter a shared forest stalker and return safely to the campfire after a catch.

entries.title: Clearer walking feedback
changes: Blocked destinations and unreachable paths now explain why your character cannot get there.

entries.title: YouTube and a richer forest
changes: Share YouTube links with friends. Forest lighting, sound and character sprites are clearer.

entries.title: A place around the campfire
changes: Gather in the campfire world and watch together. Background tabs handle shared activity more reliably.

entries.title: Worlds and shared transitions
changes: Travel between reusable worlds together, with a countdown before shared transitions.

entries.title: The first recorded prototype
changes: Customize your character, make a private space, and spend time together with shared chat and activities.
